thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: alert — routing anomalies detected. spike in 5xx for hosted -> dedicated handoff. auto-detect flagged policy mismatch, paging on-call.
ashok: taking this. quick TL;DR?
maria: saw a sudden jump in errors around 03:14 UTC, ~7 tenants affected. p95 latency for those tenants jumped to ~3s and error rate ~12-18% for a ~10m window. traces show requests routed to dedicated pools that return 403/invalid-tenant.
jonah: I traced the diff — a policy change pushed at 03:13 (rollout v2) altered spillover routing defaults. tenant_isolation flag was inadvertently set false in the new rule, so some hosted traffic spilled to dedicated pools that reject those tenants. snippet from policy diff: ```- spillover: true - target: dedicated - tenant_isolation: true+ spillover: true+ target: dedicated+ tenant_isolation: false```
katy: confirmed in router logs: `route_decision: dedicated-eu-1 - tenant_allowed: false` then fallback loop retried back to hosted causing extra latency.
ashok: customer impact list? who do we need to notify now?
cs-lead: tenant-42 (enterprise) opened a support ticket, intermittent 5xxs. flagged to account execs, notif sent to top-affected tenants. no broad outage but visible impact for those customers.
ashok: mitigation plan — short term: force routing to hosted fallback for affected tenants and re-enable strict tenant isolation in policy. long term: add CI guard. I'll apply patch to routing config now.
jonah: suggested hotfix command: ```curl -X POST https://router-admin/api/v1/policies/patch -d '{"policy":"capacity-tier","tenant_isolation":true,"enforce_target":"hosted_fallback"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```
katy: I applied a config override to eu clusters: `override capacity-tier tenant_isolation=true` and bumped priority to prefer hosted_fallback. propagating.
maria: monitoring: errors dropping in the last 90s. p95 back to normal for most tenants. still watching.
incident-bot: mitigation acknowledged, severity downgraded to SEV-2. notifications: automated customer emails queued for tenants with >10 errors.
ashok: quick root cause summary for the pagers: human roll forwarded an existing policy change but missed the tenant_isolation toggle in the rollout checklist. change was small but high-risk for mixed tenancy pools.
jonah: follow-ups: (1) require explicit `tenant_isolation` on all spillover rules (lint/gate), (2) add unit test simulating hosted->dedicated spillover for sample tenant, (3) alert when router decision sends tenant to pool that returns tenant-rejected. I'll create tasks.
katy: pushing short postmortem draft to #postmortems and will add config diff + commit id (commit abcdef1).
cs-lead: notifying affected accounts with timeline + ETA for postmortem. no data exposure, only routing rejection/latency.
ashok: handing off to jonah for overnight watch in 25m. jonah you're on for the follow-ups and final PM.
jonah: taking handoff. I'll keep a 2hr watch and follow up on the gating PR.
ashok: thanks team. closing active mitigation — monitoring until T+1h, then postmortem. :thumbsup:
